Also, on October 20, 2026, the Company plans to host a conference call and live webcast to discuss topline data from its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 for the treatment of bipolar mania.
On October 20, 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 for the treatment of bipolar mania.
The topline results, as well as additional corporate updates, are summarized below.

Phase 2 Results and Development Plans On October 20, 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 in adults experiencing acute mania associated with bipolar I disorder (“BD”).
Topline efficacy and safety data reported are from the three-week treatment period.

Upcoming milestones include: ● Focal onset seizures (“FOS”): FOCUS 1 and FOCUS 2 pivotal Phase 3 trials are enrolling. ● FOS open-label long-term safety trial: Initial data from the long-term open-label extension of the Phase 2a trial in focal onset seizures are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. ● Bipolar mania: End-of-Phase 2 Meeting with the FDA expected in the first quarter of 2027; initiation of two Phase 3 pivotal trials expected in the second half of 2027. ● Primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures (“PGTCS”): Phase 3 trial is expected to begin in the first half of 2027. ● Long-acting injectable (“LAI”): Phase 1 pharmacokinetic data for a long-acting injectable formulation of RAP-219 are expected in the third quarter of 2027. ● RAP-641: Phase 1 preliminary results are expected in the second half of 2027. ● Financial position: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had $436.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, excluding restricted cash, expected to fund operations into the second half of 2029, beyond expected topline data from the Company’s Phase 3 program in focal onset seizures.
